name: typevector-arena
description: TypeVector Arena — Typing practice and competitive platform

scripts.lint:py: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/ tests/
scripts.format:py: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format src/ tests/
scripts.format:py:check: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/
scripts.typecheck:py: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src/
scripts.test:py: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
